observations: Single photo shows an industrial-style sewing machine head mounted on a metal stand with a flat table top.
Flywheel, thread guides, presser foot, and a foot pedal mechanism are visible under the table.
A power cord is wrapped around the stand leg.

No clear, legible brand or model text can be made out on the machine head in this resolution; a watermark reading 'POSTERION JP ABI JUNE' is visible but appears to be a photo credit/overlay, not a manufacturer marking.
No accessories, manual, or power-on state are visible in the photo.
No motor box, dynamo, or clutch motor is visible under the table, which is usually required for an industrial machine to run.

claims.evidence: No video or power-on demonstration; a static photo cannot show operation.
No legible nameplate, logo, or serial tag visible in photo 0.
No motor is visible in the photo at all; cannot assess sound or function.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual are shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be confirmed from a photo; this is a seller statement only.

risks.risk: No motor/power unit visible under the table — machine may be sold as head-only without a working motor.
risks.proof: A photo showing the underside of the table with the motor, belt, and pedal linkage attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as head-only, motor not included/not working

risks.risk: Claimed smooth-running motor cannot be verified without seeing it operate.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running and stitching a scrap of fabric.

risks.risk: Brand/origin (Japanese-made) is unverified, which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the nameplate/logo on the machine arm.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories and manual not shown, may not actually be included.
risks.proof: A photo laying out the accessories and manual next to the machine.

risks.risk: General wear, rust, or table/stand damage not visible at this angle.
risks.proof: Wider, well-lit photos from multiple angles including the needle plate and bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate cosmetic wear, worst case

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric, showing the motor and pedal in action.
Close-up photo of the nameplate/logo for brand and model verification.
Photo of the motor and pedal assembly under the table.
Photo of included accessories and the original manual laid out together.
Additional angles showing the needle plate, bobbin case, and overall table/stand condition.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as an industrial lockstitch sewing machine, but working condition, motor presence, brand, and included accessories are all unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
